entries.a1f1fcfaa9d07d23: Its strength is the image recognition technology it has cultivated in the automotive field. Cumulative mass-production volume of its licensed products has surpassed 3,900,000 units, and joint development with Bosch Corporation, its capital and business alliance partner, is continuing. R&D is carried out by specialists, including holders of doctorates, and it is advancing technology development for DMS and OMS (occupant monitoring systems) with reference to automotive safety evaluation standards such as Euro NCAP.
entries.a9711076a986166f: It has set 'Make Things Intelligent' as its mission and, as its management strategy, it aims to maintain and expand the revenue base of Mobility Solutions, using image recognition AI technology as the source of its competitiveness, while accelerating the growth of DX-AI Solutions. With DX-AI Solutions expansion as a pillar of growth, it plans to advance horizontal deployment of AI technology cultivated in the mobility field into other industries, packaging of industry-specific AI, cross-selling to existing customers and expansion of partner collaboration, while incorporating trends in generative AI and LLMs (large language models).
entries.b06b41c4cf3eee98: Using image recognition and AI technology, the company develops and provides the high-precision AI character recognition engine "AI-OCR" and the drawing analysis AI "Drawing-AI". It also provides support for streamlining and automating the analysis, search and review of documents and drawings by combining generative AI and LLMs (large language models), and DX consulting that supports AI adoption and DX implementation from upstream to downstream. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
